_comment: Settings COMPARTIDAS del proyecto Runcriticon. Cada dev tiene su settings.local.json personal (ignorado). Skills en .claude/skills/, agents en .claude/agents/, hooks en .claude/hooks/. Documentación en .claude/README.md.

hooks.command: if [[ '$CLAUDE_TOOL_RESPONSE_FILE_PATH' == *'.env'* || '$CLAUDE_TOOL_RESPONSE_FILE_PATH' == *'secrets'* ]]; then echo 'Blocked: editing secrets file. Confirm intentional.' && exit 1; fi
if [[ '$CLAUDE_TOOL_RESPONSE_FILE_PATH' == *.kt ]]; then ./gradlew ktlintCheck detekt --quiet 2>&1 | tail -20; fi
